transcript: Speaker A (Woman): Coming... Whom do you want? Speaker B (Man): I came to see your neighbor Usha. Speaker A: She is at the office. Shall I call her? Speaker B: No, she asked me to leave this invitation with you. Speaker A: Okay, I'll give it to her. Speaker B (on phone): Just reached Usha's house. Since she's not home, I gave the invitation to her neighbor. Next, I'll visit Ravi and return home by 9 PM. Bye. (To woman): Thank you, I'll leave. Speaker A: Sir, you speak English so well. Where did you learn? Speaker B: I found SpeakX while doom scrolling. It improved my English and reduced my screen time. It's an AI-based app where you practice with an AI teacher who corrects you without judgment. Just 10-15 minutes daily for 2 weeks is enough. Speaker A: Isn't it expensive? Speaker B: No, it's just Rs. 2 for a 7-day trial. Speaker A: Thanks, I'll try it! Speaker B: Download SpeakX now to improve your English.
on_screen_text: Captions translating the conversation into English. End card: 'SpeakX KEY TO CONFIDENCE. INSTALL NOW. GET IT ON Google Play. Download on the App Store.'
summary: A man delivers an invitation to a woman's neighbor and speaks fluent English on a phone call. Impressed, the woman asks where he learned English, and he credits the SpeakX app, explaining how it helped him replace doom scrolling with productive daily practice. The ad concludes with a call to action to download the app, highlighting a 7-day trial for just Rs. 2.
